subject: Request: SOC2 Type II packet + targeted authn slices for ClearLake
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearlakehealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearlakehealth.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 Type II + targeted control extracts request

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well — ClearLake’s security team is collecting artifacts for our vendor risk review ahead of a contract signature. Can you provide the following for Redwood: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) and any bridge letter confirming continuity to date
- Narrow extracts/samples for authentication and privileged access controls: MFA rotation log slices, privileged account deprovisioning log, and one access-review export (CSV) covering last quarter
- Clarify audit period covered by your Type II report (start/end dates) and whether the bridge letter will cover controls since the report end date

We need an initial packet (PDF + two example log slices) by EOD Friday 21 Aug to keep our procurement timeline. If any of the requests need a different cadence or you’d prefer a secure collection link, let me know.

Also attaching our vendor questionnaire reference (SIG ID 2026-CL-008) for context.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Senior Security Analyst
ClearLake Health
security@clearlakehealth.com

Attachment: sig_reference_2026-CL-008.pdf (PDF stub)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + targeted control extracts request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We can get you a SOC2 Type II PDF and a bridge-letter draft plus targeted extracts, but want to confirm scope and handle any PII-sensitive traces via our secure share. Quick notes: 

- Audit period: our latest Type II covers 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30. Bridge letter can be provided to cover controls through 2026-08-31 if that works for you.
- For the MFA rotation log slice: do you want event-level rows (timestamps + user id + key id + rotation action) for 7/01/2026–7/31/2026 or a shorter window?
- Privileged access recert exports include user id, role, last access, and deprovision timestamp; is a CSV acceptable?

Plan: Marcus will pull the authn logs and Laura will export the access-review. We’ll stage artifacts in a secure S3 share and send a download link (encrypted) by Thu 20 Aug. If you need anything faster we’ll prioritize.

Deliverables we expect to send: SOC2 Type II PDF, bridge_letter_draft_v1.txt, 1x MFA log slice (CSV), 1x privileged_access_review_export (ZIP).

If that aligns, I’ll proceed and Marcus/Laura will coordinate direct extracts.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearlakehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + targeted control extracts request

Thanks Ben — that timeline works. A couple clarifications from my side: 

- MFA log slice: please provide 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31, event-level (timestamp, obfuscated user id, event_type, key_id). We only need 5k–10k rows; obfuscation is fine as long as unique IDs are consistent within the file.
- Privileged deprovision: include all accounts deactivated between 2026-04-01 and 2026-07-31 with the deprovision timestamp and approver if available.
- Access-review export: CSV with recertification decisions for privileged roles from the July 2026 recertification.

Also: we’ll need a short bridge letter stating there have been no control exceptions since 2025-06-30 and noting the person(s) responsible for access reviews. A draft is fine — our security legal team will circulate redlines if necessary.

If you can deliver those four artifacts (SOC2 PDF, bridge draft, MFA slice, access-review CSV) by Thu 20 Aug EOD, procurement can keep the contract slot for next week.

Thanks — Elena

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@clearlakehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II + targeted control extracts request

Elena — quick status update and delivery: 

- Attached: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (final), bridge_letter_draft_v1.txt (draft) — the bridge letter affirms no control exceptions from 2025-06-30 through 2026-08-31 and names our Security Manager (Aaron Ng) as the control owner.
- Attached: mfa_rotation_log_sample_2026-07.csv — event-level, user IDs hashed, includes timestamp, event_type, key_id. Contains ~6,300 rows (sample slice).
- Attached: privileged_access_review_export_2026-07.zip — CSV exports from our IAM recert tool; includes account, role, last_access, deprovision_timestamp, approver (where recorded).

Notes and caveats: 
- We removed full email addresses and replaced with consistent hashed IDs in the MFA slice to meet PII rules. If you need originals for audit and have an executed NDA/Data Transfer Agreement in place, we can provide raw rows via our secure share under an agreed SFTP/SSE key.
- The access-review export contains a few service accounts that were excluded from recertification due to system dependencies; we flagged those in the included README inside the ZIP.

Secure download: https://secure-files.redwood.example.com/clearlake/CL-2026-0817 (expires 7 days). HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/CL-2026-0817 (deal CL-2026-0817-REDW).

Let us know if your legal/security team has redlines on the bridge letter or needs additional slices (privileged session recordings, keystore rotation logs). We’re standing by to support the procurement timeline.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf, bridge_letter_draft_v1.txt, mfa_rotation_log_sample_2026-07.csv, privileged_access_review_export_2026-07.zip
